title: linux: tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Un servizio esaurisce il pool di connessioni/thread sotto carico normale. Trova se e' un leak o un dimensionamento e correggi. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion'
expected_reasoning: Pool exhaustion is a leak or an undersizing — measure which before changing numbers.
Instrument pool usage and lifetimes; look for connections/threads not returned.
Fix the leak or size to measured concurrency; verify headroom under load.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: tune a service hitting connection/thread pool exhaustion

possible_mistakes: Just increase the pool size and mask a leak.
Assume it's load when it's a leak.
hints: Track checkout/return of pool objects to spot leaks.
Size to measured concurrency, not a guess.
alternative_solution: Add a timeout/reaper so leaked objects are reclaimed as defense-in-depth.
edge_cases: An external dependency's slowness holds pool objects longer, mimicking a leak.
goal: Un servizio esaurisce il pool di connessioni/thread sotto carico normale. Trova se e' un leak o un dimensionamento e correggi.
